candidates.original_title: A functional polymorphism in the 5' UTR of GDF5 is associated with susceptibility to osteoarthritis
candidates.description: The GDF5 variant rs143383 is associated with susceptibility to osteoarthritis.
candidates.citation_sentence: We also tested associations between previously reported OA SNPs that were genome-wide significant or replicated across several studies (9–13), which were mostly conducted in European cohorts.
